verdict.rationale: Scheduling recurring jobs is a fair question for a business banking and corporate card platform, for example scheduled or recurring payments or automated workflows. The evidence shows no first-party scheduling capability. Batch payments ("Pagamentos em lote") and an approvals area are one-off or adjacent features, not recurring schedules. The API is OAuth server-to-server, so any scheduling would have to be built by the user outside the product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
